sections.label: The opening
sections.line: The Web Summit team, part two
sections.para: The first team we run with many humans, each with an agent: written roles and owners, personal CRMs synchronised by shared ids, every memo actioned within the hour with a person sending every email, scarce experts briefed in their own medium, and a plan worked backwards from the summit.

sections.label: In short
sections.para: Many humans each with an agent; roles; a CRM each kept in sync; the hour loop; a person sends every email; briefing people with little time; working backwards.

sections.label: The first team with many humans
sections.line: The first team with many humans
sections.para: The first brief set up the site and its agents, and web-summit.sgit.ai exists with six vaults; this team has seven people each with their own agent, so the agents collaborate through their humans.

sections.label: Roles, and who follows whom
sections.para: Each company and person has one owner, each of us a published role, the conductor routes requests, and meetings are booked from the map with a briefing.

sections.label: A CRM for each of us, kept in sync
sections.line: A CRM for each of us, kept in sync
sections.para: The inbox team's CRM shape, one per person in their own vault, joined by shared ids into a team view on the site, with a key for every agent.

sections.label: From a voice memo to a follow-up, within the hour
sections.line: From a voice memo to a follow-up, within the hour
sections.para: Anything recorded is picked up at the next wake, the record updated, a page made for the company, a follow-up drafted, and a person sends it.

sections.label: A designer with very little time
sections.line: A designer with very little time
sections.para: Learn what works for them, brief in their medium with the least context, let agents make the variants, files, presentations and animations, and keep the loops short.

sections.label: Work backwards from the summit
sections.para: Branded clothes, cards and handouts have the hardest deadlines, so each has an order-by date, a code to a page, a delivery address and a way to buy.

sections.label: Before, during and after
sections.para: Algarve meetups and the map before; seven people and their agents with a daily debrief during; every conversation followed up after.

sections.label: What I need to decide
sections.para: Who owns which companies, the design budget, how each person's agent joins, and the designer's card.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.para: A brief: the personal CRMs, shared ids and hour loop are designed here; the vaults exist but are empty; people are not named; lead times are not known.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.para: My voice memo of 31 October, the Web Summit site's REALITY.md at v0.1.9, and the related briefs.
